title: Protection for Self-employed Persons who Offer Delivery Services
what_it_is: Protection for Self-employed Persons who Offer Delivery Services

sections.label: SEP safety duties and insurance
sections.summary: Companies must take reasonably practicable safety measures for employees and SEPs, can be prosecuted under WSHA, but need not buy Work Injury Compensation insurance for SEPs.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Manpower (Mr Sam Tan Chin Siong) (for the Minister for Manpower)
sentences.text: Companies are required to take reasonably practicable measures to ensure the safety and health of both their employees and SEPs they have a contract with.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Manpower (Mr Sam Tan Chin Siong) (for the Minister for Manpower)
sentences.text: Companies can also be prosecuted under WSHA for failing their duty of care to SEPs, as well as to their own employees.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Manpower (Mr Sam Tan Chin Siong) (for the Minister for Manpower)
sentences.text: And the maximum penalty upon conviction is up to a S$500,000 fine for companies, or up to a S$200,000 fine and a two-year jail term for individuals.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Manpower (Mr Sam Tan Chin Siong) (for the Minister for Manpower)
sentences.text: Companies are not required to buy Work Injury Compensation insurance for SEPs.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Manpower (Mr Sam Tan Chin Siong) (for the Minister for Manpower)
sentences.text: This is because their relationship is one of client-contractor and not the employer-employee relationship.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Manpower (Mr Sam Tan Chin Siong) (for the Minister for Manpower)
sentences.text: However, to help SEPs get adequate insurance coverage, a Tripartite Workgroup has been formed to look into this matter as well as to address other main concerns of SEPs.

sentences.speaker: Mr Sam Tan Chin Siong
sentences.text: First, with regard to insurance for SEPs, this is really not a very straightforward issue because individual SEPs may have contracts with many companies, multiple service buyers and some of which, their contracts may be just one-off and some may just last a few times.

sentences.speaker: Mr Sam Tan Chin Siong
sentences.text: So, it is not really prudent to require all companies to purchase the insurance for every SEP because if we were to require companies to do so, then obviously, the cost for the companies will be quite high and, eventually, the cost will be passed down to the consumers.

sections.label: Court decides service buyer measures
sections.summary: The Court decides whether service buyers took necessary practicable measures on the SEP's expertise, training, protective gear and precautions.

sentences.speaker: Mr Sam Tan Chin Siong
sentences.text: The Court will have to decide whether the service buyers have taken the necessary practicable measures to ensure that the SEP under their contract has the relevant expertise, has attained the training, has worn a protective gear and also taken all the necessary precautions in carrying out the duties.
